v9zbbymm.variantName: Christmas Tree World 4ft Snowy LED Frosted Pine Fibre Optic Tree
v9zbbymm.sourceDescription: Following in the footsteps of our popular Snowy Scots Pine tree, this 4ft fibre optic tree is the ideal festive antidote to dull evenings. Coming with lightly flocked bottle brush style branches, mini acrylic flowers and pre-attached pine cones, it really is a stunning 4ft fibre optic tree that you'll be eager to display in your home. Many of our customers love this tree as it offers a more low-key version of a fully frosted Christmas tree and doesn't demand attention like our all-over kaleidoscopic fibre optics. An affordable option for anyone looking to light up their home with a sprinkling of Yuletide charm, the 4ft Snowy Frosted Pine fibre optic tree is the ultimate choice for any Xmas lover! Picture shows 6ft tree in the range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 4ft • Pre Decorated: Comes pre decorated with artificial snow, pine cones & berries • Number of Branch Tips: 124 PVC branch tips • Next-gen effects: Mesmerising lighting effects • Tree Width: 50cm diameter • No moving parts: Silent operation • Functions: Multifunctional • Foliage colour: Green • Easy assembly: Attached Branches • Sturdy base: Metal stand with plastic caps to prevent scratched floors • Indoor Use Only • Mains powered, 1.85m lead length • Height measured from the floor • Eligible for European shipping • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

4w04zxr7.variantName: Walplus 80 Branch Tips Slim Half Artificial Christmas Tree - Pink - 120 cm
4w04zxr7.sourceDescription: Create a magical holiday ambiance in your home with this artificial half Christmas tree! This Xmas tree is an ideal choice if you have limited space. Lifelike material: This beautiful Christmas tree, made of PVC material, is very lifelike in its shape and appearance.Space-saving Xmas tree: This slim Christmas tree can be placed against the wall to save more space.Economical holiday decoration: The Christmas tree can be used again every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Product Specifications Colour: Pink Material: PVC, steel Tree width: 38 cm Total height: 120 cm Stand size: 30 x 30 cm (L x W) With 80 tips Half- round Assembly required: Yes • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

xga8zf6c.variantName: Energy Light Bulbs LED Inflatable Polar Bear Christmas Decoration - 4ft
xga8zf6c.sourceDescription: Transform your outdoor or indoor holiday décor with the 4-ft LED Inflatable Polar Bear, a delightful and eye-catching decoration that's sure to spread festive cheer. Crafted from durable, weather-resistant material, this self-inflating figure stands ready in minutes—and houses internal LED lighting that casts a soft glow throughout its form. With a friendly waving pose, cheerful Santa hat, and built-in lighting, it’s a joyful focal point for your garden, porch, or living room. Equipped with a standard mains plug and featuring tethers for secure anchoring. The inflatable deflates quickly for compact storage, offering space-saving convenience and reusability for many holidays ahead. Dimensions: H 120cm, W 90cm, D 50cm. Power source: Mains-powered IP44, Suitable for: Indoor & outdoor use Comes with Ground Staking Kit with 2 metre of Wire For Plugging Pre-lit. This product is not a toy. Keep away from open flames, heat sources and unsupervised children. Long Life Lamp Company, T2 Arundel Rd Uxbridge UB8 2RP
